courseModel.js Core logic

Three pure utility functions for course visualization and offering detection. No normalization transform lives here — the catalog data shape comes from the scraper. These functions add computed values (color, edges, offered types) consumed by the planner.

Parent
core/
Called by
PlannerContext.jsx (subjectColor, extractEdges); CourseCard (color); NortheasternCalendar adapter (getOfferedFromTerms)
Imports
constants.js (SUBJECT_PALETTE)

Exported functions

subjectColor(subject) → string
Deterministic color hash. Multiplies previous hash by 31 and adds the next char code (polynomial hash), then indexes into SUBJECT_PALETTE (25 CSS hex colors from constants.js). Same subject string always produces the same color across sessions and builds — used for the left-edge stripe on CourseCard.
Returns: CSS hex color string, e.g. "#4a90d9"
extractEdges(courseId, prereqs, coreqs) → Edge[]
Walks the prereq and coreq trees recursively. At each leaf node ({ subject, number }), emits one edge. String tokens ("Or", "And", "(", ")") are skipped. Prerequisite edges carry concurrent: true when the leaf node has that flag set (indicating "may be taken concurrently").

Edges are used to draw SVG lines in RelationLines and list relationships in InfoPanel.
Returns: Edge[] — each is { from: string, to: string, type: "prerequisite"|"corequisite", concurrent?: true }
getOfferedFromTerms(terms, decodeTermCode?) → string[] | null
Maps raw catalog term codes to the set of offered semester type IDs. Each term entry may be a plain string code or an object with a .code field.

decodeTermCode (optional): an institution-specific decoder from ICalendar.decodeTermCode — takes a term code string and returns a semester type ID. When omitted, falls back to the NU Banner convention: YYYY10=fall, YYYY30=spring, YYYY40=sumA, YYYY60=sumB.

Returns null (not an empty array) when no recognisable codes are found — callers must handle this.
Returns: string[] of semester type IDs (e.g. ["fall","spring"]), or null if no codes matched
Parameters: terms = raw term entries from course data; decodeTermCode = optional ICalendar decoder (defaults to NU Banner convention)

Edge shape

// Prerequisite edge (required earlier semester)
{ from: "CS2510", to: "CS3500", type: "prerequisite" }

// Concurrent prerequisite (same semester allowed)
{ from: "MATH2321", to: "CS3500", type: "prerequisite", concurrent: true }

// Corequisite edge (must be same semester)
{ from: "CS3500", to: "CS3501", type: "corequisite" }

The type field maps to keys in REL_STYLE (from constants.js) for SVG rendering. concurrent affects evalPrereqTree's order check, not the edge type itself — concurrent prereq edges still have type: "prerequisite".

Usage pattern

import { subjectColor, extractEdges, getOfferedFromTerms } from './courseModel.js';

// Build computed fields when loading catalog data
const color = subjectColor(course.subject);
const edges = extractEdges(course.id, course.prereqs, course.coreqs);

// Map term codes to offering types
// Returns null when course has no recognisable term history
const offered = getOfferedFromTerms(course.terms); // e.g. ["fall","spring"] or null
const offeredCustom = getOfferedFromTerms(course.terms, calendar.decodeTermCode);
